newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia upper house to debate budget Wednesday-Tass.
newsitem.headline: Russia upper house to debate budget Wednesday-Tass.

text.p: Russia's upper house of parliament, the Federation Council, will debate the 1997 budget on Wednesday, Itar-Tass news agency said on Tuesday.
It quoted Federation Council Chairman Yegor Stroyev as saying Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin would head the cabinet members attending the debate.
Asked how the chamber, which represents Russia's regions and local governments, would treat the budget, he replied:
The draft envisages a deficit of 3.5 percent of gross domestic product, by Russian calculations, on revenues of 434.4 trillion roubles and expenditure of 529.8 trillion roubles.
The State Duma lower house of parliament approved the draft at a fourth final reading on January 24. It then passes to the Federation Council for consideration. -- Moscow Newsroom, +7095 941 8520
